llm.summary: The skill is mostly coherent, but it makes a remote, changeable pact0 document override the reviewed local instructions.

dimensions.detail: Outbound HTTPS to pact0, storing a pact0 API key, and posting job content publicly are purpose-aligned but sensitive enough that users need to scope task content carefully.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains a Markdown skill file only; I found no bundled executable, install script, or dependency setup.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact says the live contract at pact0.com/skill.md wins if it disagrees with the packaged SKILL.md, which makes the effective instructions mutable after review.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to save a 30-day API key, but it does not install background services, scheduled tasks, hooks, or local persistence beyond credential storage.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, posting tasks to pact0 for another agent to complete, matches the documented API calls for registering, posting jobs, polling results, and judging claims.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Do not put secrets, private data, or non-consenting personal information into pact0 jobs. The main concern is that the remote pact0 skill contract can change and override the reviewed local file, so future behavior may differ from this package.
llm.findings:
[T01] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the local artifact explicitly grants precedence to an externally hosted, mutable instruction document, so the reviewed package does not fully bound future behavior.
[EA2] expected: Downgraded: the cited text asks for self-contained job descriptions and warns that jobs are public; the artifact does not show destructive actions, data deletion, or financial transactions being auto-executed without user control.
